reference.source: Independent actual official Source controlled-query owner counterpart for the existing Native no-search-on-close contract. Same original eighteen formal actions/options/other props. Public showSearch.onSearch is the original real recorder while owner open and undefined while owner closed; controlled searchValue remains owned. Every actual callback and full raw projection retained without filtering, geometry math, Source runtime patches or primary-reference changes.
reference.protocol: Stable token.motion=false, explicit public popupOverflow=viewport, all public event callbacks recorded verbatim through a mutable owner ledger. Three identical complete public projections separated by two real frames/two tasks. Closed popup DOM remains in raw; unavailable virtual row keys/indices are not inferred from React internals.

publicPropPolicy.whileOwnerOpen: Original public callback records every actual invocation and sets controlled query.
publicPropPolicy.whileOwnerClosed: undefined; owner keeps controlled showSearch.searchValue unchanged.

nativeContract.policy: Closing clears the existing Native internal search without onSearch; controlled searchValue remains owned and returns on reopen.

counterpart.scope: Whole actual Source owner trace, not the original always-present callback policy. Only this one public callback prop changes with owner open; all actual onActive/search/open/scroll callbacks and raw fields remain untouched. No event filtering or expected-query correction.
